maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from advertising, subscriptions, book sales and real estate listings (Dow Jones, News UK, HarperCollins, REA), not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers, advertisers and businesses for subscriptions, books, ads and property listings, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own publishing, subscription, book and digital real estate businesses; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Newspapers, books and consumer media are easy to switch from; Dow Jones professional data is stickier but a smaller part.
